description: Declarative Ubuntu 26.04 LTS & Google Antigravity 2.0 Reference Layer (Corporate / Workstation Baseline)
baseline_guardrails: AGENTS.md §1 (Reusability First — scan workspace before creating duplicates)
AGENTS.md §4 (Absolute Test Inclusion — 100% branch coverage & AAA pattern)
AGENTS.md §7 (Zero-Backward Law — no legacy shims or aliases)

surface_bindings.description: Universal software quality, typing, and clean-cutover rules across all planes and scopes
invariants: AGENTS.md §1 (Reusability First — scan workspace before creating duplicates)
AGENTS.md §3 (Strict Linter & Typing Integrity — zero compiler or linter warnings)
AGENTS.md §7 (Zero-Backward Law — no legacy shims, aliases, or deprecated branches)

surface_bindings.description: Hexagonal domain boundaries, semantic types, and zero-build presentation patterns
invariants: Domain never imports from Infrastructure or Application
Consumer src/**/__init__.py and tests/**/__init__.py files must remain 0 bytes

surface_bindings.description: 100% statement and branch coverage with explicit AAA test structure
invariants: Every test method must contain explicit # Arrange, # Act, and # Assert comments
Maintain 100% statement and branch coverage with < 1s per unit test

dev.description: Local workstation or devcontainer development environment

tst.description: Automated integration, contract, and QA testing environment
default_guardrails: Verify deterministic test isolation before triggering remote QA suites
Never use production credentials or unmasked PII in tst datasets

pre.description: Pre-production staging and release validation environment
default_guardrails: Strictly read-only observability, schema drift, and contract inspection
No manual schema mutations; all migrations must flow through CI/CD
Strictly read-only telemetry, logs, and drift auditing
Explicit human operator authorization required before any external remediation

federated_mcps.description: Official Google Cloud, Gemini, Android, Firebase, and Web documentation retrieval.
federated_mcps.when_to_invoke: Invoke on demand when verifying official Google Cloud, Gemini, Android, Firebase, or Web API specifications.
federated_mcps.avoid_when: Do not invoke when inspecting local repository code, internal domain models, or offline unit tests.
